title: [feature request] customizable screen layout quick options
line: You can save the current screen layout under a name in Display Configuration and switch to it from the Meta+P screen switcher.
explanation: The Meta+P switcher and the Display Configuration widget only offered a fixed list of actions (external only, built-in only, mirror, extend left/right) that only work with exactly two screens, so people who move between several setups (work monitors only, TV only, everything) had to change each screen by hand every time. The display settings page now has a "Saved Layouts…" button that saves the applied layout (which screens are on, mode, position, scale, rotation, mirroring, priority) under a name and lets you delete saved ones; Meta+P lists the layouts saved for the currently connected screens before "Leave unchanged" and applies the chosen one. Its icons shrink when the row would be wider than the screen.

commits.message:
kcm, osd: allow saving screen layouts and switching to them with Meta+P

Switching between setups such as "work screens only" or "TV only" meant
changing every screen by hand. The display settings can now save the
current layout under a name, and Meta+P offers it for the same screens.

BUG: 491900
